items.title: Corroboration method qualification
items.question: Are the methods and actors that corroborate rubric scores identified, disclosed and qualified for their role?
items.requirement: For every corroborating control behind a score of 3, record who corroborated, how they relate to the original author, what they were exposed to, and whether the method is qualified for that role.
items.scope: method; every corroborating control in the assessed evidence
items.measurement: Corroborating methods by actor kind, independence, blindness, disclosure and qualification; methods whose stated independence or blindness contradicts the record.

checks.action: Inventory every corroborating actor and method with its relation to the original author and its exposure to scorer, reference and expected outcomes.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Qualify each method for its role and confirm that independence and blindness claims match the record.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Audit a sample of corroborating results with a separate actor and compare them with the original corroboration.
checks.when: Only when an audit is authorized

scoring.0: A corroborating method is presented as independent or blind when the record shows it is not.
scoring.1: Some corroborating methods are unidentified, unqualified or undisclosed.
scoring.2: Every corroborating method is identified, disclosed and qualified for its role; shared authorship and exposure are stated.
scoring.3: Corroboration comes from independent, blind and qualified actors, and an audit of the methods confirms them.

items.on_gap: Qualify or replace the corroborating method, or state the limitation beside each score it supports.
items.boundary: Scores the corroboration behind the rubric, not the task. It does not change any of the 23 criterion scores. Missing evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0.
items.implementation_task: Record each corroborating actor and method in the criterion evidence.
